old_problem: The source defines a unique Intel link-layer stimulus and Cscript signature, but physical UPI target mapping, accepted UC-LL versus PHY-Control branch, Windows evidence, mandatory BMC/UEFI/indicator behavior and recovery are unapproved.
disposition_reason: The method is recognizable and the one-shot Cscript operation is not intrinsically undefined, so a missing package alone does not justify BLOCKED. However ED-16 requires the exact approved harness, isolated target, deterministic oracle and recovery. The optional and OS-conflicting acceptance text changes PASS semantics and cannot be resolved by parameterization under ED-03.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 8 and 9, including exact Cscript calls, Criteria and DeepSeek fields.
Read GPT V2/historical record 2414 and preserved exact identity and hashes.
The full `error.check_upi_errors()` output and its accepted UC LL/PHY Control mapping are the defining evidence and cannot be replaced by a generic grep.
Cscript socket/port must be mapped to a physical UPI path before injection.
Windows requires an approved Windows RAS source; the BMC/UEFI `may` and front-panel `if there is one` require a deterministic applicability matrix.
No BIOS change, ITP/Cscript action, injection, reset, recovery or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Intel UPI link-layer error injection with diagnostic signature verification
test_case.purpose: Inject one approved UPI link-layer fault on each mapped socket/port and prove the exact Intel diagnostic UC link-layer or PHY-control signature, corroborating platform response and complete recovery.
required_package: Approved physical UPI topology and Cscript socket/port map
Supported Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and command semantics
Authoritative mapping of injected condition to accepted UC LL or PHY Control signature
Abort, link/system recovery and BIOS restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: After FAE approval on an isolated SUT, snapshot evidence/settings, enable only approved BIOS controls, reconcile `pcie.topology()` and `pcie.port_map()` with the physical UPI target, invoke `ei.injectUpiLLError(socket,port)` once, capture the complete `error.check_upi_errors()` output, resume and collect complete approved Windows, BMC, recovered UEFI, link-health and front-panel evidence, then restore baseline through the approved procedure.
test_case.expected_result: The exact selected UPI target reports the approved `Error = UC LL or Phy Control Error` branch consistent with the injected condition; mandatory platform logs and applicable indicator match the signed matrix; link/system recovery and BIOS restoration complete without unrelated fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified target mapping, complete one-shot transcript, the exact approved Cscript signature, all deterministic cross-plane evidence and a restored healthy baseline. Generic UPI text, unapproved alternative signature, optional/missing log treated as success, Windows/dmesg mismatch, wrong port, crash without approved recovery or incomplete restoration is not PASS.
safety_gate: Use a dedicated idle isolated SUT, stable power, independent console and qualified Intel FAE.
Preserve baseline logs/topology/settings and verify the physical target before injection.
Abort on wrong link, uncontrolled connectivity loss, crash, thermal/power anomaly, lost console or no-boot.
Do not auto-repeat, reset, retrain or power-cycle; recovery/restoration requires the approved sequence.
expected_evidence: Harness hash, topology/port map, target rationale and full injection transcript
Complete error.check_upi_errors output and signature interpretation
Approved Windows RAS, BMC SEL, recovered UEFI SEL and indicator evidence
Pre/post link health and BIOS settings
test_case.recovery: Use the approved Intel/platform sequence to recover the selected link and OS, preserve fault evidence, and compare all debug settings with baseline. Any reset, retrain, power cycle or rerun needs separate authorization.

source_conflict.reason: Windows/dmesg mismatch, optional BMC/UEFI wording and undefined front-panel applicability still require an authoritative matrix.
